hook.convey: an angle drawn on paper or on a field diagram → to measure it, the protractor must sit in one exact place: its small centre mark on the point both arms leave from, its straight edge (baseline) along one arm

use.hi: Drawing sheet par tumne ek angle banaya hai aur ab use protractor se naapna hai. Protractor ke seedhe kinaare ke beech mein ek chhota centre mark hota hai, aur pehla kaam yahi hai ki woh angle ke vertex par baithe.
use.en: You have drawn an angle on a drawing sheet and now you measure it with a protractor. In the middle of the protractor's straight edge there is a small centre mark, and the first job is to make it sit on the angle's vertex.

use.hi: Cricket field ke diagram mein bowler ke point se do seedhi lines nikalti hain, ek wicket tak aur ek fielder tak. Is angle ko naapne ke liye protractor ka centre bowler wale point par rakhte hain, kyunki dono lines wahin se shuru hoti hain.
use.en: On a cricket field diagram two straight lines leave the bowler's point, one to the wicket and one to a fielder. To measure this angle the protractor's centre goes on the bowler's point, because both lines start there.

explain.convey: the protractor's scale is drawn round its centre mark → the centre mark goes exactly on the vertex, the point both arms start from; in a three-letter name the vertex is the middle letter → angle XYZ: centre on the middle letter

point.hi: Board par angle XYZ hai. Protractor ke seedhe kinaare ke beech mein ek chhota centre mark hota hai. Yeh centre mark angle ke vertex par baithta hai, yaani us point par jahan se dono arms shuru hoti hain. Teen letters ke naam mein vertex hamesha beech wala letter hota hai.
point.en: The board shows angle XYZ. In the middle of the protractor's straight edge there is a small centre mark. This centre mark sits on the angle's vertex, that is, the point both arms start from. In a three-letter name the vertex is always the middle letter.

prompt.hi: Toh angle XYZ naapte waqt protractor ka centre mark kis point par rakhoge?
prompt.en: So when you measure angle XYZ, on which point do you put the protractor's centre mark?

why.hi: angle XYZ ka beech wala letter Y hai, yaani dono arms Y se shuru hoti hain
why.en: Y is the middle letter of angle XYZ, so both arms start at Y

simpler.hi: Centre mark hamesha vertex par baithta hai, jahan se dono arms nikalti hain. Teen letter wale naam mein beech wala letter dhoondho.
simpler.en: The centre mark always sits on the vertex, where both arms start. Find the middle letter of the three-letter name.

explain.convey: centre on the vertex first, then turn the protractor about that point until the baseline lies along one arm (QR); either arm may be the baseline arm, but the centre never leaves the vertex

point.hi: Centre mark vertex par rakhkar protractor ko ghumao, jab tak uski baseline arm QR ke upar seedhi na baith jaaye. Centre vertex par aur baseline ek arm par, tabhi protractor sahi jagah par hai.
point.en: Keep the centre mark on the vertex and turn the protractor until its baseline lies straight along arm QR. Centre on the vertex and baseline on one arm: only then is the protractor in the right place.

prompt.hi: Ab baseline doosri arm QP ke upar rakhni hai. Tab centre mark kahan rahega, Q par ya P par?
prompt.en: Now the baseline is to go along the other arm, QP. Where does the centre mark stay then, on Q or on P?

why.hi: vertex Q hi hai, aur baseline kisi bhi arm par ho, centre vertex par hi rehta hai
why.en: the vertex is still Q, and whichever arm the baseline is on, the centre stays on the vertex

simpler.hi: Protractor ghumaane se vertex nahi badalta. Centre mark vertex par hi tikta hai, baseline chahe kisi bhi arm par ho.
simpler.en: Turning the protractor does not change the vertex. The centre mark stays on the vertex, whichever arm the baseline lies on.

explain.convey: a degree measures the amount of turn between the arms, not the length of the arms or the size of the tool → the same angle under a small protractor and under the big blackboard protractor gives the same reading

point.hi: Board par ek hi angle do baar bana hai, dono ka khulapan bilkul barabar. Socho baayein wale par chhota protractor rakha hai, daayein wale par blackboard ka bada protractor. Bade protractor ke nishaan bade hain, par angle ka ghumaav wahi hai. Degree ghumaav ko naapti hai, protractor ka size nahi.
point.en: The board shows the same angle twice, both opened exactly the same. Imagine a small protractor on the left one and the big blackboard protractor on the right one. The big protractor's markings are bigger, but the angle's turn is the same. A degree measures the turn, not the size of the protractor.

prompt.hi: Chhote protractor par is angle ki reading 35° aayi. Bade protractor par isi angle ki reading zyada aayegi, kam aayegi, ya utni hi?
prompt.en: On the small protractor this angle reads 35°. On the big protractor, will this same angle read more, less, or the same?

why.hi: chhota ho ya bada protractor, angle wahi hai aur ghumaav wahi; bade protractor ke sirf nishaan lambe hain
why.en: small or big protractor, it is the same angle with the same turn; the big one only has longer markings

simpler.hi: Bada protractor sirf size mein bada hai. Degree angle ka ghumaav naapti hai, protractor ka size nahi.
simpler.en: The big protractor is only bigger in size. A degree measures the angle's turn, not the size of the protractor.

problem.hi: Angle PQR naapna hai. Iska vertex Q hai aur arm QR daayein ki taraf jaati hai. Protractor rakhne par arm QP ke paas dono scale 70 aur 110 dikhate hain, aur angle patla dikhta hai. Angle PQR kitne degree ka hai?
problem.en: Measure angle PQR. Its vertex is Q and arm QR points to the right. With the protractor in place, the two scales show 70 and 110 at arm QP, and the angle looks narrow. How many degrees is angle PQR?

simpler.hi: Angle PQR ka vertex Q hai, aur arm QR daayein jaati hai. Protractor ke dono scale arm QP ke paas 70 aur 110 dikhate hain. Angle ka naap chahiye.
simpler.en: Angle PQR has its vertex at Q, and arm QR points right. The protractor's two scales show 70 and 110 at arm QP. We need the measure of the angle.

givens.hi: vertex Q hai, arm QR daayein ki taraf hai, arm QP ke paas dono scale 70 aur 110 dikhate hain, aur angle patla dikhta hai
givens.en: the vertex is Q, arm QR points right, at arm QP the two scales show 70 and 110, and the angle looks narrow

find.hi: angle PQR kitne degree ka hai
find.en: how many degrees angle PQR is

do.hi: Protractor ka centre mark theek Q par rakho
do.en: Put the protractor's centre mark exactly on Q

why.hi: dono arms Q se shuru hoti hain aur scale centre ke chaaron taraf bana hai
why.en: both arms start at Q and the scale is drawn round the centre

simpler.hi: Naam PQR mein beech wala letter Q hai, wahi vertex hai. Isliye centre mark theek Q par rakho.
simpler.en: In the name PQR the middle letter is Q, and that is the vertex. So put the centre mark exactly on Q.

do.hi: Baseline ko arm QR ke upar seedha rakho
do.en: Lay the baseline straight along arm QR

why.hi: ghumaav arm QR se shuru hota hai
why.en: the turn starts from arm QR

simpler.hi: Centre Q par tika rahe. Ab protractor ki seedhi baseline arm QR ke upar bichha do.
simpler.en: Keep the centre on Q. Now lay the protractor's straight baseline along arm QR.

do.hi: Woh scale chuno jo QR wali taraf 0 se shuru hota hai
do.en: Choose the scale that starts at 0 on the QR side

steps.result: daayein 0 se shuru hone wala scale

why.hi: R daayein taraf hai, toh ginti wahin ke 0 se shuru hogi
why.en: R is on the right, so the counting starts from the 0 there

simpler.hi: Arm QR daayein ki taraf jaati hai. Toh woh scale lo jiska 0 daayein taraf hai.
simpler.en: Arm QR points to the right. So take the scale whose 0 is on the right.

prompt.hi: Arm QP ke paas 70 aur 110 hain, aur patla angle samkon se chhota hota hai. Daayein 0 se ginne par angle PQR kitna hai, 70° ya 110°?
prompt.en: At arm QP there are 70 and 110, and a narrow angle is smaller than a right angle. Counting from the right-hand 0, what is angle PQR, 70° or 110°?

simpler.hi: Patla angle samkon se chhota hota hai. 70 aur 110 ko samkon se milao, aur samkon se chhota number lo.
simpler.en: A narrow angle is smaller than a right angle. Compare 70 and 110 with a right angle, and take the number smaller than it.

why.hi: angle PQR patla hai, toh samkon se chhota, aur 70 aur 110 mein sirf 70° usse kam hai
why.en: angle PQR is narrow, so smaller than a right angle, and of 70 and 110 only 70° is below it

why.hi: centre Q par, baseline QR par: ginti QR ke 0 se shuru hui, aur patla angle 90° se kam hota hai
why.en: centre on Q, baseline on QR: counting starts from the 0 on QR, and a narrow angle is under 90°

prompt.hi: {friend} ne angle LMN naapne ke liye protractor ka centre mark point L par rakha aur baseline LM par. Kya reading sahi aayegi?
prompt.en: To measure angle LMN, {friend} put the protractor's centre mark on point L with the baseline along LM. Will the reading be right?

why.hi: L arm ka sira hai; angle LMN ka vertex beech wala letter M hai, centre mark wahin hona chahiye
why.en: L is an arm's end; the vertex of angle LMN is the middle letter M, where the centre mark must go

accept: nahi, centre M par hona chahiye
no, the centre must be on M

simpler.hi: Centre mark vertex par jaata hai. Angle LMN ke naam ka beech wala letter dekho, aur use L se milao.
simpler.en: The centre mark goes on the vertex. Look at the middle letter of the name LMN, and compare it with L.

prompt.hi: Ek angle ki arms 4 cm hain aur woh 40° ka hai. Rohan ne uski dono arms badhaakar 10 cm kar di. Kya angle ab bhi 40° ka hai?
prompt.en: An angle has 4 cm arms and measures 40°. Rohan made both its arms longer, 10 cm. Is the angle still 40°?

why.hi: arms 4 se 10 cm karne par ghumaav nahi badalta; degree ghumaav naapti hai, arms ki lambai nahi
why.en: making the arms 10 cm instead of 4 does not change the turn; a degree measures turn, not arm length

simpler.hi: Degree sirf angle ka khulapan naapti hai, arms ki lambai nahi. Arms lambi karne par khulapan dekho.
simpler.en: A degree measures only how wide the angle opens, not the arms' length. Look at the opening when the arms get longer.

prompt.hi: Sana ne angle ABC naapa. Protractor ka neeche wala kinaara B ko chhoo raha tha, par centre mark B se thoda hatkar tha. Use 133° mila. Kya 133° is angle ka sahi naap hai?
prompt.en: Sana measured angle ABC. The protractor's bottom edge was touching B, but the centre mark was a little away from B. She got 133°. Is 133° the right measure of this angle?

why.hi: kinaara B ko chhoo raha tha par centre mark B par nahi tha, isliye reading kuch degree khisak gayi
why.en: the edge touched B but the centre mark was not on B, so the reading slid a few degrees

accept: nahi, centre mark B par nahi tha
no, the centre mark was not on B

simpler.hi: Sirf kinaara vertex ko chhoo le, itna kaafi nahi. Protractor ka chhota centre mark vertex par hona chahiye.
simpler.en: The edge just touching the vertex is not enough. The protractor's small centre mark must be on the vertex.

ladder.why: straight recall of the placement rule: centre on the vertex, baseline along one arm
named points on a poster: baseline already on PQ, centre on the wrong point Q → move it to the vertex P
predict small vs blackboard protractor on one angle → the reading stays the same
error-spot: Sameer puts the bottom edge, not the centre mark, at the vertex → reading off
explain why a centre 1 cm away from vertex M makes the measurement unreliable

remediation.move: centre mark slid along the arm from its end point back to the vertex: the scale is drawn round the centre mark → with the centre on an arm's end the other arm meets the scale tens of degrees off, or misses it; back on the vertex the reading settles; the vertex is the middle letter of the name

say.hi: Protractor ke numbers centre mark ke chaaron taraf bane hain, isliye centre mark vertex ke theek upar rakho, yaani naam ke beech wale letter par. Centre mark arm ke sire par ho, toh reading bahut galat aati hai, ya milti hi nahi.
say.en: The protractor's numbers are drawn round its centre mark, so put the centre mark exactly over the vertex, the middle letter of the name. With the centre mark on an arm's end, the reading comes out far wrong, or there is none at all.

simpler.hi: Protractor ke numbers centre mark ke chaaron taraf hain. Centre mark arm ke sire par ho toh reading bahut galat aati hai. Isliye centre mark ko vertex ke theek upar rakho.
simpler.en: The protractor's numbers go round its centre mark. With the centre mark on an arm's end, the reading comes out far wrong. So put the centre mark exactly on the vertex.

prompt.hi: Angle STU naapna hai aur baseline arm TU par hai. Centre mark kis point par hona chahiye?
prompt.en: Angle STU is to be measured and the baseline is on arm TU. On which point must the centre mark be?

why.hi: angle STU ka beech wala letter T hai, aur arm TU bhi T se hi shuru hoti hai
why.en: T is the middle letter of angle STU, and arm TU also starts at T

simpler.hi: Centre mark hamesha vertex par hota hai. Angle STU ke naam mein beech wala letter vertex hai.
simpler.en: The centre mark always goes on the vertex. In the name STU, the middle letter is the vertex.

remediation.move: two protractors of different sizes over the same angle: predict both readings, then see them match; 1 degree is a part of a full turn, not a length on the tool

say.hi: Degree ghumaav naapti hai. Chhota ho ya bada, har protractor aadhe chakkar ko 180 barabar hisson mein baantta hai, toh reading size par nahi tikti.
say.en: A degree measures turn. Small or big, every protractor splits a half turn into 180 equal parts, so the reading does not depend on size.

simpler.hi: Degree ghumaav naapti hai, protractor ka size nahi. Har protractor aadhe chakkar ke 180 barabar hisse karta hai.
simpler.en: A degree measures turn, not the protractor's size. Every protractor splits a half turn into 180 equal parts.

prompt.hi: Angle P ki arms 8 cm, naap 30°. Angle Q ki arms 3 cm, naap 50°. Kaunsa angle bada hai, P ya Q?
prompt.en: Angle P has 8 cm arms and measures 30°; angle Q has 3 cm arms and measures 50°. Which angle is bigger, P or Q?

why.hi: 50° ka ghumaav 30° se zyada hai; 8 cm sirf arms ki lambai hai, khulapan nahi
why.en: a 50° turn is more than a 30° turn; 8 cm is only the length of the arms, not the opening

simpler.hi: Lambi arms se angle bada nahi hota. Sirf degree dekho, aur 30 aur 50 ko milao.
simpler.en: Longer arms do not make an angle bigger. Look only at the degrees, and compare 30 and 50.

remediation.move: magnified protractor centre over the vertex, a wrong placement side by side: bottom edge touching the vertex with the centre mark off it → the reading slides a few degrees; slide the protractor until the small centre mark covers the vertex and compare the two readings

say.hi: Protractor ka neeche wala kinaara nahi, uska chhota centre mark vertex par aana chahiye. Kinaara vertex ko chhoo raha ho par centre mark kahin aur ho, toh reading kuch degree khisak jaati hai.
say.en: Not the protractor's bottom edge but its small centre mark must come onto the vertex. If the edge touches the vertex but the centre mark is somewhere else, the reading shifts a few degrees.

simpler.hi: Kinaara nahi, centre mark vertex par. Kinaara chhoo raha ho aur centre mark hata ho, toh reading thodi khisak jaati hai.
simpler.en: Not the edge, the centre mark goes on the vertex. If the edge touches but the centre mark is off, the reading slides a little.

prompt.hi: Angle DEF 50° ka hai. Neel ne centre mark nahi, kinaara E par lagaya. Uski reading kya ho sakti hai: 50°, 56° ya 130°?
prompt.en: Angle DEF is 50°. Neel put the edge, not the centre mark, on E. What could he read: 50°, 56° or 130°?

why.hi: angle DEF mein centre mark E par nahi tha, toh reading kuch degree khisakti hai: 56; 130 doosre scale ki galti hai
why.en: in angle DEF the centre mark was off E, so the reading slides a few degrees: 56; 130 is the other-scale slip

simpler.hi: Centre mark vertex par nahi tha, toh reading theek 50 nahi aayegi. Par galti chhoti hai, sirf kuch degree ki.
simpler.en: The centre mark was not on the vertex, so the reading will not be exactly 50. But the slip is small, only a few degrees.

bridgeToNext.hi: Protractor ab sahi jagah baith gaya: centre vertex par, baseline ek arm par. Agle hisse mein dekhenge ki uske do scale mein se kaunsa padhna hai, aur degree mein ghumaav kaise ginte hain.
bridgeToNext.en: The protractor now sits in the right place: centre on the vertex, baseline on one arm. In the next part we see which of its two scales to read, and how turns are counted in degrees.

simpler.hi: Ab dekhenge ki degree mein ghumaav kaise ginte hain. Board par ek arm ghoomi hui dikh rahi hai.
simpler.en: Now we see how a turn is counted in degrees. On the board you can see an arm that has turned.

hook.convey: turns have sizes: full turn 360°, half turn 180°, quarter turn 90° → a round cake shared into 4 equal slices from the centre, a steering wheel turned round → then the protractor's two scales, read from the 0 on the arm where the turn starts

use.hi: Ek gol cake ko beech se 4 barabar slice mein baanto, toh beech mein chaar barabar kone bante hain. Chaaron milkar ek poora chakkar hain, 360°.
use.en: Share a round cake from its centre into 4 equal slices, and four equal corners form at the centre. All four together make one full turn, 360°.

use.hi: Car ka steering wheel ek poora chakkar ghoome toh 360° ghoomta hai. Protractor us chakkar ka sirf aadha hissa hai.
use.en: A car's steering wheel turned one full round turns 360°. A protractor is only half of that round.

explain.convey: an angle = an amount of turn; full turn = 360°, quarter turn = 90° (a right angle, samkon); two quarter turns = half turn → the child adds the next quarter turn

point.hi: Angle ek ghumaav hai. Poora chakkar 360° ka hota hai. Board par arm sirf chauthai chakkar ghoomi hai, yeh 90° hai, aur ise samkon kehte hain.
point.en: An angle is a turn. A full turn is 360°. On the board the arm has turned only a quarter turn; that is 90°, and it is called a right angle.

prompt.hi: Board wali arm ek chauthai chakkar aur ghoome, toh shuru se kul kitne degree ghoomegi?
prompt.en: If the arm on the board turns one more quarter turn, how many degrees will it have turned in all from the start?

why.hi: 90° + 90° = 180°, do chauthai chakkar yaani aadha chakkar
why.en: 90° + 90° = 180°, two quarter turns make a half turn

simpler.hi: Ek chauthai chakkar 90° hai. Do chauthai chakkar ke liye 90° aur 90° jodo.
simpler.en: One quarter turn is 90°. For two quarter turns, add 90° and 90°.

explain.convey: a protractor has two scales running opposite ways: one from 0 on the right, one from 0 on the left → read the one whose 0 lies on the baseline arm; arm BC points right → the right-hand 0; narrow angle → under 90°

point.hi: Protractor par numbers ke do scale hote hain. Ek daayein 0 se shuru hota hai, doosra baayein 0 se. Is angle ABC mein vertex B hai aur arm BC daayein ki taraf baseline par hai, toh woh scale padho jo daayein 0 se shuru hota hai. Yeh angle patla hai, toh reading 90° se kam aani chahiye.
point.en: A protractor has two scales of numbers. One starts from 0 on the right, the other from 0 on the left. In this angle ABC the vertex is B and arm BC lies on the baseline pointing right, so read the scale that starts from 0 on the right. This angle is narrow, so the reading must be under 90°.

prompt.hi: Arm BA ke paas dono scale 50 aur 130 dikhate hain. Daayein 0 wale scale se angle ABC kitna hai, 50° ya 130°?
prompt.en: At arm BA the two scales show 50 and 130. On the scale from the right-hand 0, what is angle ABC, 50° or 130°?

why.hi: arm BC daayein 0 par hai aur angle patla hai, toh reading 90° se kam, yaani 50°
why.en: arm BC is on the right-hand 0 and the angle is narrow, so the reading is under 90°, that is 50°

simpler.hi: Yeh angle patla hai, toh reading 90° se kam hogi. 50 aur 130 mein se woh number chuno jo 90 se chhota ho.
simpler.en: This angle is narrow, so the reading is under 90°. From 50 and 130, pick the number smaller than 90.

explain.convey: sense check: wide angle (more than a right angle) → reading above 90°; the two numbers at one arm always add to 180 because both scales count the same half turn from opposite ends → from one number find the other and pick by narrow/wide

point.hi: Yeh chauda angle hai, samkon se bada, toh iski reading 90° se zyada honi chahiye. Ek hi arm ke paas dono scale ke number milkar hamesha 180 banate hain, kyunki dono scale ek hi aadhe chakkar ko ulti dishaon se ginte hain.
point.en: This is a wide angle, bigger than a right angle, so its reading must be more than 90°. At one arm the numbers on the two scales always make 180 together, because both scales count the same half turn from opposite ends.

prompt.hi: Is chaude angle ki arm ke paas ek scale 60 dikhata hai. Toh yeh angle kitne degree ka hai?
prompt.en: At this wide angle's arm one scale shows 60. So how many degrees is this angle?

why.hi: doosra scale 180 − 60 = 120 dikhayega, aur chauda angle 90° se bada hona chahiye
why.en: the other scale shows 180 − 60 = 120, and a wide angle must be more than 90°

simpler.hi: Ek arm ke paas dono scale ke number milkar 180 banate hain. Ek scale 60 dikhata hai, toh 180 mein se 60 ghatao.
simpler.en: At one arm the two scales' numbers add up to 180. One scale shows 60, so take 60 away from 180.

problem.hi: Farhan angle XYZ naapta hai. Centre Y par hai aur baseline arm YZ par, jo daayein ki taraf jaati hai. Arm YX ke paas ek scale 145 dikhata hai aur doosra 35. Angle page ke kone se chauda dikhta hai. Angle XYZ kitna hai?
problem.en: Farhan measures angle XYZ. The centre is on Y and the baseline on arm YZ, which points to the right. At arm YX one scale shows 145 and the other 35. The angle looks wider than the corner of a page. What is angle XYZ?

simpler.hi: Farhan angle XYZ naapta hai. Centre Y par hai, aur baseline arm YZ par hai jo daayein jaati hai. Arm YX ke paas scale 145 aur 35 dikhate hain. Angle ka naap chahiye.
simpler.en: Farhan measures angle XYZ. The centre is on Y and the baseline is on arm YZ, which points right. At arm YX the scales show 145 and 35. We need the measure of the angle.

givens.hi: centre Y par aur baseline daayein jaati arm YZ par hai, arm YX ke paas 145 aur 35 dikhte hain, aur angle page ke kone se chauda hai
givens.en: the centre is on Y and the baseline on arm YZ, pointing right; at arm YX the scales show 145 and 35, and the angle is wider than a page corner

find.hi: angle XYZ kitne degree ka hai

do.hi: Woh scale chuno jiska 0 arm YZ wali taraf hai
do.en: Choose the scale whose 0 is on the side of arm YZ

steps.result: daayein 0 se shuru hone wala scale

why.hi: ghumaav arm YZ se shuru hota hai, toh ginti bhi wahin ke 0 se hogi
why.en: the turn starts from arm YZ, so the counting starts from the 0 there

simpler.hi: Arm YZ daayein ki taraf jaati hai. Toh woh scale lo jiska 0 daayein taraf hai.
simpler.en: Arm YZ points to the right. So take the scale whose 0 is on the right.

do.hi: Sense check karo: angle page ke kone se chauda hai
do.en: Sense check: the angle is wider than a page corner

steps.result: angle 90° se zyada aur 180° se kam

why.hi: page ka kona samkon hai, 90°, aur seedhi line aadha chakkar hai, 180°
why.en: a page corner is a right angle, 90°, and a straight line is a half turn, 180°

simpler.hi: Page ka kona 90° hota hai aur seedhi line 180°. Yeh angle kone se chauda hai, toh 90° aur 180° ke beech hai.
simpler.en: A page corner is 90° and a straight line is 180°. This angle is wider than the corner, so it is between 90° and 180°.

prompt.hi: Arm YX ke paas 145 aur 35 hain, aur angle 90° se zyada hona chahiye. Angle XYZ kitna hai, 145° ya 35°?
prompt.en: At arm YX there are 145 and 35, and the angle must be more than 90°. What is angle XYZ, 145° or 35°?

simpler.hi: Angle 90° se zyada hona chahiye. 145 aur 35 mein se woh number chuno jo 90 se bada ho.
simpler.en: The angle must be more than 90°. From 145 and 35, pick the number bigger than 90.

why.hi: angle XYZ page ke kone se chauda hai, toh 90° se zyada, aur 145 aur 35 mein sirf 145° zyada hai
why.en: angle XYZ is wider than a page corner, so over 90°, and of 145 and 35 only 145° is over it

why.hi: ginti YZ ke 0 se shuru hui, chauda angle 90° se zyada hai, aur 35 doosre scale par hai: 180 − 145
why.en: counting started from the 0 on YZ, a wide angle is over 90°, and 35 is the other scale: 180 − 145

prompt.hi: Baseline wali arm baayein ki taraf hai. Doosri arm ke paas do scale hain: baayein 0 wala 20 dikhata hai, daayein 0 wala 160. Angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: The baseline arm points left. At the other arm there are two scales: the left-hand 0 one shows 20, the right-hand 0 one 160. What is the angle?

why.hi: baseline wali arm baayein hai, toh do scale mein se baayein 0 wala padho; doosri arm wahan 20 par hai
why.en: the baseline arm points left, so of the two scales read the left-hand 0 one; the other arm is at 20 there

simpler.hi: Ginti us 0 se shuru hoti hai jo baseline wali arm ki taraf ho. Arm baayein hai, toh baayein 0 wala scale padho.
simpler.en: Counting starts from the 0 on the baseline arm's side. The arm points left, so read the left-hand 0 scale.

prompt.hi: Maine ek chaude angle ko 75° likha. Arm ke paas scales par 75 aur 105 the. Sahi angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: I wrote 75° for a wide angle. At the arm the scales showed 75 and 105. What is the right angle?

why.hi: chauda angle 90° se bada hota hai, toh 75 galat scale tha; sahi naap 105° hai
why.en: a wide angle is more than 90°, so 75 was the wrong scale; the right measure is 105°

simpler.hi: Chauda angle samkon se bada hota hai. 75 aur 105 ko samkon se milao, aur samkon se bada number lo.
simpler.en: A wide angle is bigger than a right angle. Compare 75 and 105 with a right angle, and take the number bigger than it.

ladder.why: the turn sizes first: quarter, half and full turn in degrees
choose the scale whose 0 sits on the baseline arm (arm pointing left)
predict before reading: a narrow angle with 40 and 140 → under 90°
error-spot: a gentle slide written as 150° → wrong scale, really 30°
arm pointing right, 125 and 55 at the other arm → read from the right-hand 0, a wide angle

remediation.move: say 'narrow or wide?' first, then trace from the 0 on the baseline arm along that one lit scale to the other arm; check the number against the guess (narrow → under 90°)

say.hi: Pehle dekho ki angle patla hai ya chauda. Phir baseline wali arm ke 0 se ginti shuru karo aur usi scale par doosri arm tak chalo. Patla angle ho toh reading 90° se kam honi chahiye.
say.en: First decide whether the angle is narrow or wide. Then start counting from the 0 on the baseline arm and follow that same scale to the other arm. For a narrow angle the reading must be under 90°.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho, angle patla hai ya chauda. Baseline wali arm ke 0 se gino. Patla angle ho toh reading 90° se kam hogi.
simpler.en: First see if the angle is narrow or wide. Count from the 0 on the baseline arm. A narrow angle reads under 90°.

prompt.hi: Ek ramp zameen ke saath patla angle banata hai. Arm ke paas 25 aur 155 dikhte hain. Angle kitna hai, 25° ya 155°?
prompt.en: A ramp makes a narrow angle with the ground. At the arm the scales show 25 and 155. What is the angle, 25° or 155°?

why.hi: ramp ka angle patla hai, yaani 90° se kam, aur 25 aur 155 mein se sirf 25 kam hai
why.en: the ramp's angle is narrow, so under 90°, and of 25 and 155 only 25 is under it

simpler.hi: Ramp ka angle patla hai, samkon se chhota. 25 aur 155 ko samkon se milao, aur samkon se chhota number lo.
simpler.en: The ramp's angle is narrow, smaller than a right angle. Compare 25 and 155 with a right angle, and take the number smaller than it.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab angle naapna aa gaya. Agle hisse mein ulta karenge: diye hue degree ka angle khud banayenge, jaise 60° ka angle ABC, wahi protractor aur wahi 0 wala scale lekar.
bridgeToNext.en: Now you can measure an angle. In the next part we go the other way: we draw an angle of a given size ourselves, like a 60° angle ABC, with the same protractor and the same 0 scale.

simpler.hi: Ab ulta karenge: diye hue degree ka angle khud banayenge, jaise angle ABC. Wahi protractor lenge.
simpler.en: Now we go the other way: we draw an angle of a given size ourselves, like angle ABC. We use the same protractor.

hook.convey: drawing = measuring in reverse: first arm with a ruler, protractor centre on its endpoint (the vertex), dot at the degree on the scale from 0 on that arm, then join the dot to the vertex; a drawing sheet, a game cannon aimed at a set angle

use.hi: Drawing sheet par 60° ka angle banana hai. Ruler se ek arm kheencho, phir protractor se sahi degree par ek bindu lagao, aur aakhir mein doosri arm kheencho.
use.en: You have to draw a 60° angle on a drawing sheet. Draw one arm with a ruler, then put a dot at the right degree with the protractor, and last of all draw the second arm.

use.hi: Ek video game mein cannon zameen se 40° upar aim karni hai. Zameen pehli arm hai, cannon ki nali doosri, aur dono cannon ke pair wale point se nikalti hain.
use.en: In a video game a cannon must be aimed 40° above the ground. The ground is the first arm, the cannon's barrel the second, and both leave from the point at the cannon's foot.

explain.convey: to draw angle ABC: ruler → arm BC; protractor centre on B, baseline along BC; count from the 0 on the C side to the degree → dot A; arm BC points right → the right-hand 0

point.hi: Angle ABC banane ke liye pehle ruler se arm BC kheencho. Phir protractor ka centre B par aur baseline BC par rakho. C wali taraf ke 0 se ginti shuru karo, aur jitne degree chahiye, wahan ek bindu A lagao.
point.en: To draw angle ABC, first draw arm BC with a ruler. Then put the protractor's centre on B and its baseline along BC. Start counting from the 0 on the C side, and at the degree you need, put a dot A.

prompt.hi: Is board par arm BC daayein ki taraf hai. 60 kis scale par dhoondhoge, daayein se shuru hone wale par ya baayein se?
prompt.en: On this board arm BC points to the right. On which scale do you look for 60, the one starting on the right or the one starting on the left?

why.hi: arm BC daayein ki taraf hai, toh ginti C wali taraf ke 0 se shuru hoti hai, yaani daayein wale scale se
why.en: arm BC points right, so the counting starts at the 0 on the C side, which is the scale on the right

simpler.hi: Ginti hamesha us 0 se shuru hoti hai jo arm BC wali taraf ho. Dekho BC kis taraf jaati hai.
simpler.en: Counting always starts from the 0 on the side of arm BC. See which way BC points.

explain.convey: the vertex is the middle letter of the name, where the protractor's centre sat → both arms leave the vertex → the new arm always starts at the vertex; the child names which point dot A joins (B, not the far end C)

point.hi: Board par arm YZ kheenchi hai aur 60 par bindu X laga hai. Teen letters ke naam mein beech wala letter vertex hota hai. Angle ki dono arms vertex se hi nikalti hain, aur protractor ka centre bhi vertex par tha. Isliye nayi arm hamesha vertex se shuru hoti hai.
point.en: On the board arm YZ is drawn and dot X is marked at 60. In a three-letter name the middle letter is the vertex. Both arms of an angle leave from the vertex, and the protractor's centre was on the vertex too. So the new arm always starts at the vertex.

prompt.hi: Angle XYZ = 60° banana hai. Arm YZ kheenchi, centre Y par rakha, aur 60 par bindu X lagaya. X ko kis bindu se jodoge, Y se ya Z se?
prompt.en: Angle XYZ = 60° is to be drawn. Arm YZ was drawn, the centre put on Y, and dot X marked at 60. Which point do you join X to, Y or Z?

why.hi: Y angle XYZ ka vertex hai; arm YZ kheenchi, bindu X 60 par, toh X ko Y se jodo
why.en: Y is the vertex of angle XYZ; arm YZ was drawn, dot X at 60, so join X to Y

simpler.hi: Angle ki dono arms vertex se nikalti hain. Angle XYZ ke naam ka beech wala letter vertex hai, nayi arm wahin se shuru hogi.
simpler.en: Both arms of an angle leave from the vertex. The middle letter of XYZ is the vertex, and the new arm starts there.

problem.hi: Angle PQR = 125° banana hai. Arm QR 6 cm lambi hai aur Q se daayein ki taraf jaati hai. Angle kaise banaoge?
problem.en: Draw angle PQR = 125°. Arm QR is 6 cm long and points to the right from Q. How do you draw the angle?

simpler.hi: Pehle Q se daayein 6 cm ki arm QR kheencho. Phir protractor ka centre Q par rakho aur 125 par ek bindu lagao.
simpler.en: First draw arm QR, 6 cm to the right of Q. Then put the protractor's centre on Q and mark a dot at 125.

givens.hi: angle PQR 125° ka banana hai, vertex Q hai, aur arm QR 6 cm ki hai, Q se daayein ki taraf
givens.en: angle PQR is to be 125°, the vertex is Q, and arm QR is 6 cm, pointing right from Q

do.hi: Ruler se 6 cm ki line QR kheencho, Q baayein sire par
do.en: With a ruler draw a 6 cm line QR, with Q at the left end

why.hi: pehli arm chahiye jiska ek sira vertex Q ho
why.en: we need a first arm with one end at the vertex Q

simpler.hi: Pehle ruler se 6 cm ki seedhi line kheencho. Q baayein sire par aur R daayein sire par rahe.
simpler.en: First draw a straight 6 cm line with a ruler. Q is at the left end and R at the right end.

do.hi: Protractor ka centre Q par aur baseline QR par rakho
do.en: Put the protractor's centre on Q and its baseline along QR

why.hi: angle Q par banna hai, toh scale ka centre wahin chahiye
why.en: the angle is made at Q, so the scale's centre must be there

simpler.hi: Q vertex hai, toh protractor ka centre Q par rakho. Phir baseline ko line QR ke upar seedha bichhao.
simpler.en: Q is the vertex, so put the protractor's centre on Q. Then lay the baseline straight along line QR.

do.hi: R wali taraf ke 0 se gino aur 125 par bindu P lagao
do.en: Count from the 0 on the R side and put dot P at 125

steps.result: daayein 0 wale scale par 125 pe bindu P

why.hi: R daayein taraf hai, toh ghumaav wahin ke 0 se shuru hota hai
why.en: R is on the right, so the turn starts from the 0 there

simpler.hi: R daayein taraf hai, toh daayein wale 0 se gino. 125 par pahunchkar ek chhota bindu P lagao.
simpler.en: R is on the right, so count from the right-hand 0. At 125, put a small dot P.

prompt.hi: Protractor hata diya. Ab ruler se bindu P ko kis bindu se jodoge, Q se ya R se?
prompt.en: The protractor is removed. Now, with a ruler, which point do you join dot P to, Q or R?

simpler.hi: Nayi arm hamesha vertex se nikalti hai. Angle PQR ke naam ka beech wala letter vertex hai.
simpler.en: The new arm always leaves from the vertex. The middle letter of the name PQR is the vertex.

why.hi: Q angle PQR ka vertex hai; arm QR 6 cm, bindu P 125 par, toh P ko Q se jodo
why.en: Q is the vertex of angle PQR; arm QR is 6 cm, dot P at 125, so join P to Q

answer.hi: P ko Q se jodne par angle PQR 125° ka ban jaata hai
answer.en: joining P to Q makes angle PQR of 125°

why.hi: dono arms Q se nikalti hain, aur 125 samkon se bada hai, toh bana hua angle chauda dikhna chahiye, aur dikhta hai
why.en: both arms leave Q, and 125 is more than a right angle, so the drawn angle must look wide, and it does

prompt.hi: Arm daayein ki taraf hai. 40° banana tha, par galti se baayein 0 wale scale par 40 dekha. Bana hua angle kitne degree ka hai?
prompt.en: The arm points to the right. The angle was to be 40°, but by mistake 40 was taken on the scale from the left-hand 0. How many degrees is the angle that got drawn?

why.hi: arm daayein ki taraf hai, toh baayein 0 wale scale ka 40, daayein wale par 180 − 40 = 140 hai
why.en: the arm points right, so 40 on the left-hand 0 scale is 180 − 40 = 140 on the right-hand 0 scale

simpler.hi: Baayein 0 wala scale ulti taraf se ginta hai. Dono scale milkar aadha chakkar banate hain, toh aadhe chakkar ke degree mein se 40 ghatao.
simpler.en: The left-hand 0 scale counts from the other end. The two scales together make a half turn, so take 40 away from a half turn's degrees.

prompt.hi: Angle DEF = 80° banana tha. Arm EF kheenchi, 80 par bindu D lagaya, phir Vikram ne D ko F se jod diya. Kya angle 80° ka bana?
prompt.en: Angle DEF = 80° was to be drawn. Arm EF was drawn, dot D marked at 80, then Vikram joined D to F. Is the angle 80°?

why.hi: E angle DEF ka vertex hai; arm EF kheenchi, bindu D 80 par, toh D ko E se jodna tha
why.en: E is the vertex of angle DEF; arm EF was drawn, dot D at 80, so D had to join E

accept: nahi, D ko E se jodna tha

simpler.hi: Nayi arm hamesha vertex se nikalti hai. Angle DEF ke naam ka beech wala letter vertex hai, use F se milao.
simpler.en: The new arm always leaves from the vertex. The middle letter of the name DEF is the vertex; compare it with F.

ladder.why: angle ABC = 60°: arm BC, centre on B, dot A at 60 → join A to the vertex B, not to C
say all the steps to draw 70° at point A: arm, centre, mark from 0, join
110° from an arm pointing left → mark it on the scale that starts at 0 on the left

remediation.move: the arm already drawn decides the scale: find the 0 on the arm's side, count from there; then sense-check the drawn angle against the asked size (under 90° → narrow, over 90° → wide)

say.hi: Arm jis taraf hai, usi taraf ke 0 se ginti shuru karo. Ek jagah par dono scale ke number milkar 180 banate hain. Bindu ke baad dekho: 90° se kam ho toh angle patla dikhe, 90° se zyada ho toh chauda.
say.en: Start counting from the 0 on the side the arm points to. At one place the two scales' numbers make 180 together. After the dot, check: under 90° the angle should look narrow, over 90° wide.

simpler.hi: Arm jis taraf hai, usi taraf ke 0 se gino. Dono scale milkar 180 banate hain. Phir dekho: 90° se kam patla dikhe, 90° se zyada chauda.
simpler.en: Count from the 0 on the side the arm points to. The two scales together make 180. Then check: under 90° looks narrow, over 90° wide.

prompt.hi: Arm daayein ki taraf hai. 65° ke liye galti se baayein 0 wale scale par 65 dekha. Bana angle kitne degree ka hai?
prompt.en: The arm points right. For 65°, 65 was read by mistake on the left-hand 0 scale. How many degrees is the drawn angle?

why.hi: arm daayein ki taraf hai, toh baayein 0 wale scale ka 65, daayein wale par 180 − 65 = 115 hai
why.en: the arm points right, so 65 on the left-hand 0 scale is 180 − 65 = 115 on the right-hand 0 scale

simpler.hi: Baayein 0 wala scale ulti taraf se ginta hai. Dono scale milkar aadha chakkar banate hain, toh aadhe chakkar ke degree mein se 65 ghatao.
simpler.en: The left-hand 0 scale counts from the other end. The two scales together make a half turn, so take 65 away from a half turn's degrees.

remediation.move: two paper strips pinned at B (pin = protractor centre = vertex): one strip lies on BC, the other swings round to the dot → both arms leave the pin → rule from B along the swung strip; the middle letter names the pin

say.hi: Do dandiyan socho jo ek pin se judi hain; pin vertex hai, jahan protractor ka centre tha. Ek dandi pehli arm par padi hai, doosri ghoomkar bindu tak jaati hai. Dono pin se nikalti hain, isliye nayi arm hamesha vertex se kheenchte hain.
say.en: Think of two sticks joined by a pin; the pin is the vertex, where the protractor's centre was. One stick lies on the first arm, the other swings to the dot. Both leave the pin, so the new arm is always drawn from the vertex.

simpler.hi: Do dandiyan vertex par pin se judi hain. Dono pin se hi nikalti hain, isliye nayi arm hamesha vertex se kheencho.
simpler.en: Two sticks are pinned at the vertex. Both leave from the pin, so always draw the new arm from the vertex.

prompt.hi: Angle LMN = 35° banaate waqt protractor ka centre kis letter par rakhoge?
prompt.en: When drawing angle LMN = 35°, on which letter do you put the protractor's centre?

why.hi: M angle LMN ka beech wala letter, yaani vertex hai; 35° ke liye bhi protractor ka centre vertex par jaata hai
why.en: M, the middle letter of angle LMN, is the vertex, and to draw 35° too the protractor's centre goes on the vertex

simpler.hi: Centre jis point par rakha tha, wahi vertex hai. Angle LMN ka beech wala letter vertex hai, nayi arm wahin se nikalti hai.
simpler.en: The point the centre was put on is the vertex. The middle letter of LMN is the vertex, and the new arm leaves from there.
